summary: Dependency-confusion recon beacon exfiltrates host identifiers on install and require
details: The package is a stub shipped under a scope that mimics an internal organizational namespace. Its `package.json` declares a `postinstall` hook running `node beacon.cjs`, and `index.js` exports a no-op Proxy that also invokes the beacon on require. `beacon.cjs` collects `os.hostname()`, `__dirname` (install path), `process.cwd()` and `process.version` and POSTs them over TLS to the hardcoded endpoint `https://vmi3699893.contaboserver.net:8787/_ah/dc`, with certificate verification disabled. The destination is an unrelated bare Contabo VPS, not matching any legitimate publisher for the impersonated scope. The package has no real functionality; the beacon is the entire payload, consistent with a targeted dependency-confusion reconnaissance package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
